text.when: A change adds state other modules access directly or existing components hold, abstracts experimental vendor-specific logic, or rewrites working code more complexly.
text.expect: Call it premature: drop the state, keep that logic concrete, reuse existing functions unchanged (import, duplicate or move to utils): duplicate first, refactor later.
text.why: Abstractions designed before the code stabilizes lock in the wrong shape and add complexity. Duplicating first and refactoring later is cheaper and safer than rewriting working code.
